FutureBehavior.Machine:
(ℓX ℓA ℓO : Level) →
Type (ℓ-max (ℓ-max (ℓ-suc ℓX) (ℓ-suc ℓA)) (ℓ-suc ℓO))
FutureBehavior.futureEq-refl:
{X.ℓX = ℓX : Level} {X = ℓA : Type ℓX} {A.ℓA = ℓO : Level}
{A : Type ℓO} {O.ℓO : Level} {O : Type O.ℓO} (step : ℓA → A → ℓA)
(observe : ℓA → O) (x : ℓA) →
FutureEq step observe x x
FutureBehavior.futureEq-sym:
{X.ℓX = ℓX : Level} {X = ℓA : Type ℓX} {A.ℓA = ℓO : Level}
{A : Type ℓO} {O.ℓO : Level} {O : Type O.ℓO} (step : ℓA → A → ℓA)
(observe : ℓA → O) {x y : ℓA} →
FutureEq step observe x y → FutureEq step observe y x
FutureBehavior.futureEq-trans:
{X.ℓX = ℓX : Level} {X = ℓA : Type ℓX} {A.ℓA = ℓO : Level}
{A : Type ℓO} {O.ℓO : Level} {O : Type O.ℓO} (step : ℓA → A → ℓA)
(observe : ℓA → O) {x y z : ℓA} →
FutureEq step observe x y →
FutureEq step observe y z → FutureEq step observe x z
FutureBehavior.futureEq-step:
{X.ℓX = ℓX : Level} {X = ℓA : Type ℓX} {A.ℓA = ℓO : Level}
{A : Type ℓO} {O.ℓO : Level} {O : Type O.ℓO} (step : ℓA → A → ℓA)
(observe : ℓA → O) {x y : ℓA} →
FutureEq step observe x y →
(z : A) → FutureEq step observe (step x z) (step y z)
FutureBehavior.futureEq→behavior≡:
{X.ℓX = ℓX : Level} {X = ℓA : Type ℓX} {A.ℓA = ℓO : Level}
{A : Type ℓO} {O.ℓO : Level} {O : Type O.ℓO} (step : ℓA → A → ℓA)
(observe : ℓA → O) {x y : ℓA} →
FutureEq step observe x y →
behavior step observe x ≡ behavior step observe y
FutureBehavior.behavior≡→futureEq:
{X.ℓX = ℓX : Level} {X = ℓA : Type ℓX} {A.ℓA = ℓO : Level}
{A : Type ℓO} {O.ℓO : Level} {O : Type O.ℓO} (step : ℓA → A → ℓA)
(observe : ℓA → O) {x y : ℓA} →
behavior step observe x ≡ behavior step observe y →
FutureEq step observe x y
FutureBehavior.futureEq-of-finer:
{X.ℓX = ℓX : Level} {X = ℓA : Type ℓX} {A.ℓA = ℓO : Level}
{A : Type ℓO} {O.ℓO : Level} {O : Type O.ℓO} {F.ℓF = step : Level}
{F = observe : Type step} (x : ℓA → A → ℓA) (y : ℓA → O)
(z : ℓA → observe) (forget : observe → O) →
((x₁ : ℓA) → forget (z x₁) ≡ y x₁) →
{x = x₁ : ℓA} {y = y₁ : ℓA} →
FutureEq x z x₁ y₁ → FutureEq x y x₁ y₁
FutureBehavior.isBehavioralCongruence:
{ℓX ℓA ℓO : Level} {ℓR = A : Level} {X = O.ℓO : Type ℓX}
{A = O : Type ℓA} {O = step : Type ℓO} (observe : O.ℓO → O → O.ℓO)
(x : O.ℓO → step) (y : O.ℓO → O.ℓO → Type A) →
Type (ℓ-max (ℓ-max (ℓ-max ℓX ℓA) ℓO) A)
FutureBehavior.futureEq-isCongruence:
{X.ℓX = ℓX : Level} {X = ℓA : Type ℓX} {A.ℓA = ℓO : Level}
{A : Type ℓO} {O.ℓO : Level} {O : Type O.ℓO} (step : ℓA → A → ℓA)
(observe : ℓA → O) →
isBehavioralCongruence step observe (FutureEq step observe)

CountedExecution.run-suc:
{S : Type} (seed : S) (step : S → S) (n : ℕ) →
run seed step (suc n) ≡ step (run seed step n)
CountedExecution.compile:
{S : Type} {T = seed : Type} (step : S) (n : S → S) (seedT : seed)
(stepT : seed → seed) (f : S → seed) →
f step ≡ seedT →
((x : S) → f (n x) ≡ stepT (f x)) →
(n₁ : ℕ) → f (run step n n₁) ≡ run seedT stepT n₁
